}}'''Jerinvar Barstere''' is the mayor of [[Watch Hill]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jerinvar Barstere}}

== Appearance ==
Jerinvar is a stocky man with a wide nose and a leathery-face tanned from years working in [[tabac]] fields. He is past middle-age with hair that is turning white.{{ref/book|4|56}}

== Activities ==
Jerinvar was in office as Watch Hill's mayor in {{Ne|999}} when [[Dain Bornhald]] occupied his town with a force of [[Whitecloaks]]. As troubles mounted in the [[Two Rivers]], he and others in his village became concerned for the security of [[Emond's Field]] - most especially after seeing smoke rising to the south of their area. Eventually, a plea for aid was personally delivered by [[Faile Bashere]] and Jerinvar responded immediately by mustering all men and boys of fighting age to join their southern neighbors in battle. After a days march he and his men arrived to participate in the final hour of the [[Battle of Emond's Field]] and helped to defeat the [[shadowspawn]] attempting to penetrate the north defensive perimeter around the village.

At the conclusion of the battle he approached [[Perrin Aybara]] with the Watch Hill [[Village Council]] to assure Perrin that the people of Emond's Field can always count on Watch Hill to help in times of need. After deferring to Perrin and Faile - as if to sovereign lords - he leads his men back to Watch Hill.{{ref/book|4|56}}
